overloads.semanticRole: Copies the contents, style, and formulas from a range into a plain object, optionally restricted to specific data categories and optionally removing the copied data afterward (cut semantics).

constraints: If rangeObj is a combined range, only the first range is used.
options.copy defaults to True (keep the copied values/formatting/formulas after execution); False removes them (i.e. behaves like a cut).

options.copyOptions selects what is copied via vk clipboard options constants (all, formatting, formulas, formulas and formatting, values, or values and formatting); defaults to vk clipboard options all.
Workbook paste-options settings are taken into account when copying.
